s.0: Shows when this product is part of a mix & match bundle. Needs the Bundle tray app embed on. Words and look: CRO Toolbox → Bundles → Design.
s.1: Which of the section's designs made in the app to show.
s.2: Steps, products and the look are set in CRO Toolbox → Bundles. Shoppers pay the bundle product's price, and each picked item's stock goes down.
s.3: Lets shoppers build your mix & match bundles anywhere: Add to bundle on product pages, + buttons on collection pages and a tray that follows them. Set it up in the app: Bundles.
s.4: Shows Cross-sell rules that have "Cart drawer" ticked, inside your theme's slide-out cart. Works with Dawn and themes built on it. Heading, products and button are set in CRO Toolbox → Cross-sell offers → Design.
s.5: Products, headline and discount come from your Cross-sell rules; the look is set in CRO Toolbox → Cross-sell offers → Design.
s.6: Offers come from your Upsell rules in CRO Toolbox; their look and wording are set in the app: Upsell offers → Design.
s.7: Videos, their order and linked products, the look and the pages it shows on are all set in CRO Toolbox → Video carousel.
s.8: Place it under the Add to cart button. Add-ons, texts and colours are set in the app: Offers & bundles → Add-ons.
s.9: Messages, icons, dates and the look are set in the app: Boosters → Announcement bar.
s.10: Put it inside the product information, above the Add to cart button. Fields, preview and fee are set in the app: Offers & bundles → Personalization.
s.11: This product's reviews. Reviews and how they look are set in the app: Sections → Product page reviews.
s.12: Adds a button to every product card; products with sizes or colours open a small picker. The look is set in the app: Boosters → Quick add to cart.
s.13: Reviews and how they look are set in the app: Sections → Customer reviews.
s.14: Goal, messages, colours and where it shows are set in the app: Boosters → Free shipping bar.
s.15: Put it inside the product information, under the Add to cart button. Words and look are set in the app: Boosters → Back in stock & pre-order.
s.a: Sticky add to cart, stock urgency, trust badges, sales pop-ups and bundle deals. Edit them in the app: Boosters and Bundles.
s.b: Add it to the cart page. Words, dates and look are set in the app: Offers & bundles → Gift note & delivery date.
s.c: The slide-out cart, express checkout buttons, best discount and shareable carts. Set them up in the app: Boosters → Cart drawer & checkout.
s.d: Collections, order, colours and sizes are set in the app: Sections → Collection pills.
s.e: Fields, texts, colours and sizes are designed in the app: Header & pages → Contact page.
s.f: Which of the countdown's designs made in the app to show.
s.g: Place it in the Header or Footer area, on the home page, on product pages or on the cart page. Each place has its own design, set in the app: Countdown timers.
s.h: Which of the designs made in the app to show.
s.i: Put it inside the product information (under the price or Add to cart) or on the cart page. Dates and words are set in the app: Boosters → Delivery estimate.
s.j: Questions and the look are set in the app: Sections → FAQ. Here you only choose what this copy shows.
s.l: Optional, e.g. Shipping. Empty = all questions.
s.n: Optional. Empty = the heading set in the app.
s.o: Help Google show these questions in search
s.p: Adds FAQ structured data. Use it on one page only.
s.q: Keep it in the Footer area. Columns, menus, newsletter, social links and colours are set in the app: Header & pages → Footer.
s.r: Keep it in the Header area. Layout, logo, menu, icons, colours and glass effects are set in the app: Header & pages → Header. The menu comes from Online Store → Navigation.
s.s: Images, text and look are set in the app: CRO Toolbox → Sections → Hero banners.
s.x: Images, texts, sizes and arrows are set in the app: Sections → Image carousel.
s.y: Logos, their order and the look are set in the app: Sections → Scrolling logos and text.
s.z: Add it to a page (e.g. Track your order, or Returns) and choose which one it is. Words and look are set in the app: Header & pages → Track order / Returns.
